_lisezmoi: Traduction anglaise de la médiathèque (sources/mediatheque.json). Seuls les textes se traduisent : les photos, leur ordre et les fichiers restent ceux du fichier français.
Chaque galerie est repérée par son slug ; « photos » donne le texte alternatif de chaque photo (lu par les lecteurs d'écran, affiché en légende dans la visionneuse), dans l'ordre du fichier français.
Dans WordPress : la traduction anglaise de la page Médiathèque, avec les textes alternatifs traduits dans la médiathèque WordPress (Polylang).

sardine.description: At sea, the teams are developing the Sardine field through water injection, workover operations and the drilling of new wells, with safety as the top priority.

GOC team and contractor working on a piece of equipment on the platform

Red box of life jackets on the platform deck

tsiengui.description: Taken over by GOC in March 2024 together with the Obangué field, Tsiengui marks the State's recovery of its energy sovereignty. Its storage capacity is being expanded.

mboumba.description: The company's first production permit, obtained in 2016, the mature Mboumba field showcases the teams' expertise: production, laboratory analysis and a strong safety culture.

obangue.description: The first field operated directly by the company, Obangué was taken over in March 2024. Its storage capacity is being expanded.

akondo.description: Deep in the Gabonese forest, the onshore Akondo permit, operated by GOC, brings together storage tanks, processing units and the teams' buildings on a single site.
photos: Aerial view of the Akondo site: storage tanks, sheltered processing units and a telecommunications mast surrounded by forest

Overview of the Akondo site, with its red-roofed buildings and storage tanks under a cloudy sky
